name: open-in-editor
description: Open a file in VS Code using the 'code' command. Supports opening at a specific line:column via file:line:col syntax with the -g switch.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Path to the file to open in VS Code

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Line:column to open at (e.g. 42, 42:5, or 1 for file start). Defaults to 1 if omitted.
